## Daylo AI - Setup

**Models:** NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano 30B A3B (intent, extraction, scheduling, chat) and Nemotron 3 Super 120B A12B (urgency summary), served by Nebius Token Factory (`https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1`).

1. Create a **Header Auth** credential: Name `Authorization`, Value `Bearer <NEBIUS_API_KEY>`. Select it on the 5 Nemotron HTTP nodes.
2. Create a Google **Service Account** credential for your Firebase project; select it on the 3 Firestore nodes.
3. Replace `YOUR_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID` (Firestore nodes) and `YOUR_FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY` (Verify Firebase Token node).
4. Activate the workflow and point the web app at the production webhook URL (`/webhook/founder-assistant`).
5. The webhook expects `Authorization: Bearer <Firebase ID token>` and a JSON body with `message` and optional `timezone`.

nodeGroups.name: Read incoming request
nodeGroups.description: Checks the Firebase sign-in, rejects strangers, then works out what the founder is asking for

nodeGroups.name: Remember new task
nodeGroups.description: Pulls the task, person and due date out of the message and stores it in the task list

nodeGroups.name: Load open tasks
nodeGroups.description: Reads the founder's open tasks, then sends status questions one way and planning requests the other

nodeGroups.name: Summarize urgent work
nodeGroups.description: Answers status questions with the most urgent open work first

nodeGroups.name: Plan and save schedule
nodeGroups.description: Schedules or moves tasks, replaces past or clashing times, and writes the new times back to each task

nodeGroups.name: Send reply
nodeGroups.description: Returns one chat reply to the app for every kind of request
